rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data as arguments to some commands, such as git clone, can allow arbitrary commands to be executed.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: If a dollar assertion '$' appears in a regular expression before another term that cannot match the empty string, then this assertion can never match, so the entire regular expression cannot match any string.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings to construct code may allow a malicious user to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Embedded Malicious Code
rules.description: Transforming hard-coded data (such as hexadecimal constants) into code to be executed is a technique often associated with backdoors and should be avoided.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: An assignment to a local variable that is not used later on, or whose value is always overwritten, has no effect.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
rules.description: Creating a temporary file that is accessible by other users can lead to information disclosure and sometimes remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
